short: Talk About Daily Life and Routines in English

sentences.t: Hello and welcome back to Leo English podcast.
We're happy you're joining us for another friendly conversation on Leo English podcast.

Our mission is to help you understand everyday English and speak more comfortably.
We use natural conversations, simple explanations, and useful examples.
Today we're talking about daily life and routines.
That includes waking up, preparing meals, working, studying, and enjoying some free time.
These topics help you connect with classmates, colleagues, neighbors, and friends.
You don't need an unusual life to have something interesting to say.

Listen for useful patterns you can change to describe your own day.

A routine is your usual way of doing things, often in a familiar order.

When describing your routine, words like usually, sometimes, and rarely show how often something happens.

And I rarely skip lunch means it doesn't happen very often.

I usually walk, but with be, we say I'm usually hungry.
